Black Friday is LIVE! Lowest prices of the year to get your X6 storewide 🛒 👉 https://bit.ly/YTB_ExclusiveOffers

Experience cinematic travel filmmaking with Insta360 X6, the compact 360 camera that captures travel, action, and cinematic footage in one. In this video, Jannik Wieland 
@jannikwlnd  takes Insta360 X6 on a sailing trip through Greece and puts it to the test, creating three different films with one camera: a travel vlog, an action short, and a cinematic highlight reel. See how he captures every angle, then reframes his footage in post.

With 360 capture, a compact design, and 10-bit Log for flexible color grading, X6 is ready for everything from fast-paced action to cinematic travel moments.

Pair it with accessories to capture unique angles, whether you're filming in a Greek town square, getting low for running shots, or mounting the camera to a boat ceiling.

See how Jannik brings it all together, from reframing 360 footage in Insta360 Studio and subject tracking with Dee
title: Can one camera really do it all? - Insta360 X6
